verdict.rationale: Gusto now offers banking and a Money Dashboard, so flagging anomalous or out-of-policy transactions is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the pack documents AI-driven anomaly or policy flagging for review. The cash-flow dashboard, webhooks, MCP server and CLI are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI flag anomalous or out-of-policy transactions automatically for review
